title: GraphArena: Evaluating and Exploring Large Language Models on Graph Computation

layout.note: Three full-width tinted bands stacked top to bottom: green with four P cards, blue with six NP cards wrapped around a central GraphArena title and logo row, salmon with a left-to-right Problem Generation, LLM Inference, Scorer pipeline beside a two-by-two reasoning quadrant. lesson: Show a benchmark's scope as a grid of identical dashed cards, one tiny toy instance per task with its answer coloured, sorted into tinted bands by problem class; then trace a single instance through prompt, several model answers and traffic-light verdicts.
